resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says a tent camp was first used and the lookout constructed in 1934, as a groundhouse with a catwalk. Forest Lookouts and Rex's page date an L-4 cab to 1937, and Rex's page says a camp was used in 1934. Both dates and both designs are recorded; the sources do not settle which is right.
Rex's page says it burned in a 2018 forest fire; Idaho Fire Lookouts says destroyed in fire in 2018. Both sources agree on the year and on the loss.

notes_for_editor: Brief's 1934 build year is supported by the register but disputed by Forest Lookouts and Rex's page (1937 L-4 cab); both are recorded. Brief's design 'L-4' is supported by two sites but the register describes a groundhouse. The 2018 fire is supported only by the two Idaho-area lookout sites: two web searches found no report naming this lookout in a 2018 fire. The 1946 staffing item is a newspaper quote via a secondary site. No photos added: no image URLs were in the crawl text.
